summary: Solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx at each supplied angular frequency from one fixed seed.

identity.relation: angular-frequency sequence and fixed kx seed to signed complex roots and exit diagnostics
identity.direction: angular-frequency sequence and fixed kx seed to signed complex roots and exit diagnostics
identity.definition: Each frequency independently starts from kx_start and solves det(D)=0 with source-compatible complex trust-region dogleg arithmetic and bounded iteration/evaluation counts.
identity.coordinates: complex perpendicular wavenumber plane; frequencies remain in caller order
identity.boundary: multiple signed roots may exist; exit flags and residuals expose nonconvergence without mirroring roots
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: 背景磁场强度，经色散行列式进入回旋频率

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: 各组分电荷，决定回旋频率符号
inputs.constraints: 有限，元素数与其余组分数组一致。

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: 各组分质量，进入热速度与回旋频率

inputs.name: ns0
inputs.description: 各组分绝对数密度，进入等离子体频率

inputs.name: Ts0
inputs.description: 各组分温度，已按声明的约定换算为开尔文

inputs.name: omegas
inputs.description: 待求根的角频率序列；各频点独立求根并重复使用同一 `kx_start` 初值，不作频率间延续
inputs.constraints: 非空有限数组且元素非零，因为频率出现在共振分母中。

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: 波矢平行磁场分量，固定不变并进入平行共振宗量
inputs.constraints: 有限；允许为零（算例 2 取 `kz=0.0`），此时平行共振宗量退化为 $\omega/\omega_{cs}$。

inputs.name: kx_start
inputs.description: 延续求根的起始复初值 `x01=(0.6+0.0i)*kn`
inputs.constraints: 有限；只影响收敛到哪个根，不影响根本身的存在性。

inputs.name: tol_fun
inputs.description: 对应 the reference runtime `TolFun` 的残差相对收敛阈值
inputs.constraints: 有限且严格为正，默认 `1e-16`（`optimset` 取值）。

inputs.name: tol_x
inputs.description: 对应 the reference runtime `Tolx` 的变量相对步长收敛阈值
inputs.constraints: 有限且严格为正，默认 `1e-16`（`optimset` 取值）。

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: 对应 the reference runtime `MaxIter` 的每个频点最大迭代次数
inputs.constraints: 不小于 1，默认 400（the reference runtime 默认值）。

inputs.name: max_function_evals
inputs.description: 对应 the reference runtime `MaxFunEvals` 的每个频点最大目标函数求值次数
inputs.constraints: 不小于 1，默认 100（the reference runtime 对标量未知量取 `100*numel(x0)`）。

outputs.name: roots
outputs.description: 逐频点求得的复垂直波数根

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.description: 各根处的色散行列式残差 $\mathcal{D}$
outputs.constraints: 有限复数；根的质量须由该残差与 `last_updates` 共同判断。

outputs.name: determinant_scale
outputs.description: 各根处介电张量元素的模最大值，用作该频点行列式残差的抵消量级基准
outputs.constraints: 非负有限；`abs(residuals)/determinant_scale` 即该根的相对零点质量。

outputs.name: exit_flags
outputs.description: 各频点的 the reference runtime `fsolve` 退出标志（`1` 残差达标、`2` 步长达标、`3` 残差下降达标、`-2` 雅可比退化、`-3` 信赖域收缩到无意义、`0` 达到迭代或求值上限）

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: 各频点实际使用的迭代次数

outputs.name: function_evals
outputs.description: 各频点实际的目标函数求值次数

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: 各频点退出标志是否为正（即 the reference runtime 判定收敛）
outputs.constraints: 为假时根仍是行列式的数值驻点或未收敛点，调用者须按 `residuals` 与 `determinant_scale` 自行判定是否接受。

outputs.name: omegas
outputs.description: 本次实际使用的角频率序列，回显输入

outputs.name: kz
outputs.description: 本次求根使用的平行波数，回显输入

outputs.name: kx_start
outputs.description: 本次求根使用的起始初值，回显输入

outputs.name: tol_fun
outputs.description: 本次使用的残差阈值，回显输入

outputs.name: tol_x
outputs.description: 本次使用的变量阈值，回显输入

outputs.name: max_iterations
outputs.description: 本次使用的迭代上限，回显输入

outputs.name: max_function_evals
outputs.description: 本次使用的求值上限，回显输入

outputs.name: solver
outputs.description: 求根算法的文字标识，供调用者核对所用的数值路径

preconditions: multiple signed roots may exist; exit flags and residuals expose nonconvergence without mirroring roots
supported: Solve the Ronnmark determinant for complex kx at each supplied angular frequency from one fixed seed.
excluded: No mode identity or arbitrary-parameter accuracy is inferred beyond the declared numerical method.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for declared invalid inputs; numeric conversion errors may propagate for unsupported Python objects.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical backend errors propagate; no fallback relation is substituted.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Exit flags and residuals expose bounded nonconvergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.

python.signature: solve_kinetic_wavevector_roots(*, B0, qs, ms, ns0, Ts0, omegas, kz, kx_start, tol_fun=1e-16, tol_x=1e-16, max_iterations=400, max_function_evals=100)
